Metagenomic multi-tier profiles - combining MAGs, contigs, and reads

SOP: Metagenome 8 - Multi-tier profiles

Metagenomic multi-tier profiles - combining MAGs, contigs, and reads

  • Introduction
  • Requirements
  • 1. Get contigs that are/aren’t included in MAGs
    • 1.1. Combine contigs files together for all sets of MAGs
    • 1.2. Identify which contigs appear in final/nrMAGs
    • 1.3. Taxonomic classification of contigs that aren’t in MAGs
  • 2. Get best alignment for all reads
  • 3. Collate read-by-read output for each sample
    • 3.1. Collate all annotations for each read for each sample (if you didn’t already do this)
    • 3.2. Get preferred annotation for each read for each sample
    • 3.3. Combine this with MAG > contig > read-based
  • 4. Collate output for all samples

Introduction

Requirements

1. Get contigs that are/aren’t included in MAGs

1.1. Combine contigs files together for all sets of MAGs

1.2. Identify which contigs appear in final/nrMAGs

1.3. Taxonomic classification of contigs that aren’t in MAGs

Assuming that you’re already run the taxonomic assignment and understand this, so give abridged version?

2. Get best alignment for all reads

3. Collate read-by-read output for each sample

3.1. Collate all annotations for each read for each sample (if you didn’t already do this)

3.2. Get preferred annotation for each read for each sample

3.3. Combine this with MAG > contig > read-based

4. Collate output for all samples
